import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Data from the documents for years 1942-1966
# Treasury bonds and Moody's AAA corporate bonds

years = list(range(1942, 1967))

# From 1960 document (page 71) for 1942-1959
treasury_1942_1959 = [2.46, 2.47, 2.48, 2.37, 2.19, 2.25, 2.44, 2.31, 2.32, 2.57, 2.68, 2.94, 2.55, 2.84, 3.08, 3.47, 3.43, 4.08]

treasury_1960_1966 = [4.02, 3.90, 3.95, 4.00, 4.15, 4.21, 4.65]
moodys_1960_1966 = [4.41, 4.35, 4.33, 4.26, 4.40, 4.49, 5.13]

# Combine all data
treasury = treasury_1942_1959 + treasury_1960_1966
moodys = moodys_1942_1959 + moodys_1960_1966

print("Year | Treasury | Moody's AAA")
for i, y in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{y} | {treasury[i]:.2f} | {moodys[i]:.2f}")

# Calculate correlation coefficient
correlation = np.corrcoef(treasury, moodys)[0, 1]
print(f"\nCorrelation coefficient: {correlation}")
